text: The Patriots face the Raiders this Sunday in a matchup complicated by significant defensive absences, as Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis—the team's starting cornerbacks—have been ruled out due to shoulder and neck injuries respectively, forcing the secondary into unfamiliar territory against Kirk Cousins and a surprisingly productive Raiders offense. On the brighter side, running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice, offering some relief to the offensive weapons, while the edge rusher trio of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas has exceeded expectations through the first four games and will need to generate pressure to compensate for the coverage vulnerabilities. The Sunday matchup carries special significance as the Patriots will honor Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during a halftime ceremony, and the team will sport throwback uniforms for the occasion, with the ceremony streaming live on Patriots.com. Notably, several experts have expressed more confidence in New England's chances despite the injury situation, suggesting the Patriots have reasons for optimism even with six players ruled out heading into Week 5.
